description:
The available templates

TIP: Lists the legacy templates intents are built from (security baselines and template-based Endpoint security profiles). Each has displayName, description, templateType (securityBaseline, diskEncryptionConfiguration, firewall, ...), templateSubtype, platformType, versionInfo, isDeprecated, intentCount. Resolve an intent's templateId here. Supports $filter, $top, $skip, $select, $count.
